card.text: Everything whose light has had time to reach us, out to the microwave background.

introduction.text: Everything whose light has reached us: galaxies and quasars out to 6.6 Gpc and, at its edge, the cosmic microwave background, light from 372,000 years after the Big Bang.

off.title: Galaxies and quasars, without the sphere
off.summary: The galaxies and quasars inside the observable universe, with the cosmic microwave background left out of the view.

cutaway.title: The microwave background, cut open
cutaway.summary: Planck's map of the oldest light, its northern half open to the galaxies inside. Zoom out past the edge to see it.

full.title: The whole cosmic microwave background
full.summary: Planck's map of the oldest light on the sphere it left from. It shows only from outside: zoom out past the edge.
